```lean
theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} {γ : Type u_3} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {mγ : MeasurableSpace γ} [MeasurableSpace.CountablyGenerated γ] (κ : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel α (γ × ℝ)) [ProbabilityTheory.IsFiniteKernel κ] : ProbabilityTheory.IsRatCondKernelCDF (fun p q => κ.density κ.fst p.1 p.2 (Set.Iic ↑q)) κ κ.fst := by
  let μ := κ.measure
  let π₁ := κ.fst
  let cond_cdf := fun p q => κ.density κ.fst p.1 p.2 (Set.Iic ↑q)

  have h_cond_cdf_measurable_in_q : ∀ p, measurable (fun q => cond_cdf p q) := by
    intro p
    let f := fun q => κ.density κ.fst p.1 p.2 (Set.Iic ↑q)
    have : measurable f :=
      by
        apply measurable_comp
        · exact measurable_set_Iic
        · exact measurable_density κ.fst
    exact this

  have h_cond_cdf_non_decreasing : ∀ p, ∀ q₁ q₂, q₁ ≤ q₂ → cond_cdf p q₁ ≤ cond_cdf p q₂ := by
    intro p
    intro q₁ q₂
    intro hq
    have : cond_cdf p q₁ ≤ cond_cdf p q₂ :=
      by
        rw [cond_cdf]
        rw [cond_cdf]
        apply le_cdf_of_le
        exact hq
    exact this

  have h_cond_cdf_right_continuous : ∀ p, ∀ q, ∀ ε > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ q', q < q' < q + δ → |cond_cdf p q' - cond_cdf p q| < ε := by
    intro p
    intro q
    intro ε
    intro hε
    let δ := ε / 2
    have : δ > 0 := by linarith
    use δ
    intros q'
    intro hq
    have : |cond_cdf p q' - cond_cdf p q| < ε :=
      by
        rw [cond_cdf]
        rw [cond_cdf]
        apply abs_cdf_right_continuous
        exact hq
    exact this

  have h_cond_cdf_zero_at_neg_infty : ∀ p, lim_{q → -∞} cond_cdf p q = 0 := by
    intro p
    have : lim_{q → -∞} cond_cdf p q = 0 :=
      by
        rw [cond_cdf]
        apply lim_cdf_at_neg_infty
    exact this

  have h_cond_cdf_one_at_pos_infty : ∀ p, lim_{q → ∞} cond_cdf p q = 1 := by
    intro p
    have : lim_{q → ∞} cond_cdf p q = 1 :=
      by
        rw [cond_cdf]
        apply lim_cdf_at_pos_infty
    exact this

  exact ProbabilityTheory.IsRatCondKernelCDF.mk cond_cdf h_cond_cdf_measurable_in_q h_cond_cdf_non_decreasing h_cond_cdf_right_continuous h_cond_cdf_zero_at_neg_infty h_cond_cdf_one_at_pos_infty
```
